title: Minecraft BEST SUGAR CANE FARM 1.21 - Java & Bedrock - 4500+ PER HOUR!
description:
Hello Everybody TheySix Is here with a New Minecraft Tutorial, In this Tutorial I Will Show you how to make a Simple Easy Mega Sugar Cane Farm In Minecraft 1.21

📚This sugar cane farm is simple easy to build and so extremely fast this farm can produce +4500 Sugar Canes Per Hour ! 
📚Recommended ( Optional ) : If you want to use the maximum efficiency of this farm, place the observers fully on top of the pistons ( 8 observers in total for each side )
📚This farm will work on both platforms ( Java Edition & Bedrock Edition )
📚You can build this farm on the Minecraft servers!
📚 If you want to produce more than +4500 per hour, you have to make more layers, there is no limit.
